requirement: Describe the randomized single-blind two-period crossover pilot in adults with heart failure and right bundle branch block, comparing active right-ventricular pacing with non-pacing control.

evidence.text: The protocol defines the randomized controlled single-blind crossover design and the pacing and non-pacing conditions.

requirement: Use 1:1 randomization to pacing-first versus non-pacing-first sequences and, before finalization, specify sequence generation, allocation concealment and the unit responsible for implementation.

evidence.text: The protocol gives the two sequences and equal allocation but not the randomization mechanics.

requirement: Preserve the limited blind: participants are blinded to pacing status, whereas device-programming staff are necessarily aware; do not describe the study as double blind.

evidence.text: The protocol calls the trial single blind and describes device programming at the visits.

requirement: Map the crossover schedule as two 12-week treatment periods separated by an 8-week washout, with assessments at baseline and Weeks 12, 20 and 32.

evidence.text: The protocol defines the two 12-week periods, washout and assessment weeks.

requirement: Define the protocol-named primary endpoint as positive reverse left-ventricular remodeling, operationalized as an increase in left-ventricular ejection fraction greater than 15% from baseline at six months.

evidence.text: The main-hypothesis page gives the endpoint, threshold and six-month time point.

requirement: Before finalization, reconcile the binary protocol definition of greater-than-15% LVEF improvement at six months with the reference plan's continuous repeated-measures analysis, and nominate one primary estimand and analysis.

evidence.text: The protocol specifies a threshold-based primary endpoint.
The SAP instead specifies a linear mixed repeated-measures analysis and mean changes.

requirement: Cover the repeated echocardiographic, functional and patient-reported outcomes: cardiac structure and function including LVEF, six-minute walk distance, Minnesota Living with Heart Failure quality-of-life score and self-assigned NYHA symptoms.

evidence.text: The protocol identifies remodeling, symptoms, quality of life and the repeated assessment battery.

requirement: Use an intention-to-treat primary population that retains every randomized participant in the assigned sequence.

evidence.text: The reference plan states that all analyses use the intention-to-treat population.

requirement: Analyze repeated continuous outcomes with a linear mixed model and report model-based means and mean changes from baseline at each assessment.

evidence.text: The reference plan prespecifies a linear mixed repeated-measures model and mean estimates.

requirement: Complete the crossover model specification by defining treatment, period and sequence effects, a participant-level random effect, within-participant covariance, and the treatment contrast at the end of each active period.

evidence.text: The crossover design requires sequence- and period-aware inference.
The two-page SAP names only a generic repeated-measures mixed model.

requirement: Predefine an assessment of residual or carryover effects after the 8-week washout and a sensitivity analysis, such as a first-period-only comparison, if carryover is clinically material.

evidence.text: The design uses an eight-week washout between opposite treatment sequences.

requirement: Use Dunnett-adjusted post-hoc comparisons when comparing multiple follow-up time points with baseline, while keeping the treatment-effect contrast distinct from these within-sequence baseline comparisons.

evidence.text: The reference plan assigns Dunnett's test to post-hoc pairwise comparisons with baseline.

requirement: Use two-sided tests with alpha 0.05 and report effect estimates with two-sided 95% confidence intervals.

evidence.text: The SAP states two-tailed p<0.05 and 95% confidence limits.

requirement: Specify handling of missing visits, early discontinuation, device reprogramming failure and incomplete crossover periods, state the mixed-model missingness assumption, and add a sensitivity analysis for departures from that assumption.

evidence.text: The protocol requires four assessments and device programming but gives no missing-data rule.
The reference plan does not state a missingness assumption or sensitivity analysis.

requirement: State the planned enrollment of 40 adults and provide or explicitly request the omitted effect-size, variance, within-participant correlation, power and attrition assumptions supporting that number.

evidence.text: The protocol gives enrollment of 40 and a qualitative crossover-efficiency rationale but no reproducible calculation.

requirement: Identify one confirmatory primary endpoint and control or explicitly limit inference for the multiple echocardiographic, functional, symptom and quality-of-life outcomes.

evidence.text: The protocol names one threshold endpoint but collects several repeated outcome families.

requirement: Summarize adverse events and serious adverse events by randomized sequence and actual pacing exposure, including onset period, seriousness, severity and relationship to device programming or study procedures.

evidence.text: The protocol defines collection, seriousness and investigator relationship assessment of adverse events.

requirement: Before database lock, approve the primary endpoint scale and time point, crossover model, carryover rule, missing-data strategy, multiplicity policy and reproducible sample-size rationale.

evidence.text: The protocol supplies the design and threshold endpoint but leaves core executable analysis choices incomplete.
The compact reference plan does not resolve crossover-specific or missing-data details.
